schema: Independent route and declared frame audit v1

rows.method: Exact states/foot contacts are offline labels only. Dense root position and quaternion define actual physical movement/facing. Headings use declared axes, not renderer. Phase travel headings are endpoint displacement vectors; local speed is finite difference. Out uses archived40ms full play qposes outside its available1kHz4.301–6.999s dense metrology window; exact saved poses are merged without interpolation. Low speed headings are omitted.

ball_flight_offline.note: Some legacy pass metrics call world X advance downfield. That label does not equal declared field depth in rotated Out or Slant coordinates. Football final7qpos ABI verified in prior model audits.
